svg.title: Every turn's voice-to-voice time
svg.desc: The cumulative share of every measured turn's voice-to-voice time, pooled over each configuration's runs, on a log scale from 1 to 20 s with the SLO of 2.03 s and the 95th percentile marked, and beside it the share of each configuration's replies that began within the SLO as a bar: voice alone, 295 replies over 5 runs: 100% within the SLO, the slowest at 2.04 s; tuned vLLM, 590 replies over 10 runs: 10% within the SLO, the slowest at 18.62 s; preempt-resubmit, 295 replies over 5 runs: 56% within the SLO, the slowest at 3.37 s; the configuration to deploy, 885 replies over 15 runs: 68% within the SLO, the slowest at 3.71 s.
svg.text: Voice-to-voice time of a reply (s, log scale)
